summary: Added a shared companion/MCP tool adapter that classifies read/write/execute/external risk, binds the complete Contract v2 mutation to the approval request and execution payload, validates that binding inside the companion against artifacts, commands and the current Git snapshot, normalizes tool telemetry and failures, fails closed for mutating MCP names, and redacts secrets before model context or failure telemetry.
